Robert, saw Wavetronix pushing SmartSensor HD as the loop replacement and expanding across new regions.

That kind of growth usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Wavetronix off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Robert, quick follow-up for Wavetronix.

As the SmartSensor footprint expands, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Wavetronix needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
